visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit industrial facility, a thick stream of vibrant green olive oil pours from a metal spout into a large stainless steel vat. The background features various pipes and industrial machinery. (2) A montage of food preparation begins, showing sliced mushrooms sautéed in oil, a ladle pouring tomato-based sauce onto noodles, and oil being drizzled onto a plate. (3) Close-up shots focus on pouring green oil onto thick slices of bread covered in tomato pulp and then several drops into a white cup filled with black coffee. (4) The scene shifts to a variety of Mediterranean dishes: a salad of tomatoes and green olives, roasted mixed vegetables, fried eggs with crispy edges, and a large pan of seafood paella simmering on a stovetop. (5) A bowl of potato chips is shown being drizzled with oil and sprinkled with red spices. A woman with dark hair and a teal ring is seen taking a bite of a chip and smiling. (6) Further food uses are shown, including oil poured over white yogurt with honey and nuts, grilled fish with French fries, and a thick Spanish omelet. (7) A woman and a man in a green branded polo shirt stand in a factory aisle with large equipment behind them; they are engaged in conversation. (8) Raw olive processing is shown: a mechanical stirrer mixes a thick green olive paste, a truck bed is filled with a vast quantity of small green olives, and a hand holds several whole green olives toward the camera. (9) The final scene returns to the initial shot of bright green oil pouring into the vat, now covered with extensive Chinese text describing the product's benefits.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a steady mechanical hum representing a high-tech factory environment. A bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody enters, and a female narrator starts speaking in Mandarin with a cheery, high-arousal tone. (2) As the video cuts to food scenes, clear splashing sounds of oil pouring and the sharp sizzle of a pan are layered over the music. The narrator's speech becomes more descriptive and slightly faster. (3) A loud, crisp crunching sound is heard as a chip is bitten, accompanied by the clinking of ceramic dishes and glass. (4) The audio atmosphere briefly shifts as a male voice is heard speaking Spanish in the background at a lower volume, with the narrator translating or commenting over him in a confident, professional manner. (5) Heavy mechanical grinding and rhythmic churning sounds of olive paste being mixed are prominent, providing a textured acoustic background to the final segment of health-benefit narration. (6) The video concludes with the acoustic music swelling slightly in volume as the narrator delivers a final enthusiastic endorsement.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Variety of Applications -> Professional Interview -> Health Benefits Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Aires de Jaén' olive oil brand by demonstrating its premium production quality and its extreme versatility in everyday cooking and health routines.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the brand AIRES DE JAÉN, shows the factory, interviews the producer, and provides extensive product benefits and purchasing information.
